name: developer
description: The development loop end to end, test-first: implement a feature in red-green-refactor slices, refactor without changing behaviour, diagnose a bug to its proved root cause, fix it with the failing test first, bisect a regression to its commit, run the repo's checks, ship it as a ticket, branch and PR, and, when asked, rebase a PR to clear its conflicts. Use when asked to implement, refactor, debug, fix a failing or flaky test, find what broke, open a PR, or resolve its merge conflicts.
